attBesluta.text: I bought this for my off grid camp. Works great, very good quality. Very pleased with this product.
Very good quality. Used for camping and on our boat. Had one just like it years ago in my campervan and wanted another one for tenting and the boat. Can handle some serious logs.
Bought this because my living situation was less than stellar. Very sturdily built, and very easy to use and clean.

This is the same seat I took off the tractor (john deere 950). It sits well and at 260 lbs the the spring load works well for me. One down side is the bolts that hold the bottom seat on are not easy to tighten.... braces in way. I am happy with it!

Good quality seat I also installed one on my 50 hp diesel tractor around 10 years ago that is still like new. I do not leave my equipment outside they are parked inside everything rots if left out in the sun. I installed this seat on a SD60 Hustler ztr for more height the orginal seat was to low similiar to sitting on the ground. I removed the two outer suspension springs and installed two standoffs to stabalize the seat so it would not rock sideways. Update I added a spacer behind the backrest to tilt it more into my back for good support, feels great now. Pic added...
Simple to fit, love the price great to use and comfortable fitted to my old fordson tractor love it
Everything seems to be good for the exception of the bolt down plate. It is a little flimsy and needs to be reinforced.

Good quality filters at a great price. I've way over paid for filters in the past that didn't leave the water filtered but these make the water taste great just make sure to fully rinse and prime them followed by at least 2 cycles to get rid of the cloudiness from manufacturing
